name: shuohao-skills
description: AI 短剧制作的 skill 集合：拆角色、排大纲、出场景与道具设定、写剧本、切分镜 | Agent skills for AI short-drama production — character bibles, adaptation outlines, art bibles, screenplays, storyboards. Runs in Claude Code & codex.

capability_evidence.skills-plugins: en source, built and battle-tested on real AI short-drama production.

friction.note_en: Easy. install via native installer / package; needs git clone (build from source); configure API key configuration
friction.note_zh: 较易上手。可通过 native installer / package 安装；需要 git clone (build from source)；需配置 API key configuration

analysis.summary_en: Agent-agnostic skills for AI short-drama production
highlights: Style bleed. The five reports share 57 class names, 13 of which mean different things in different reports (.copy, .kpis, .badge, .chip…), so every selector gets a scope prefix
Asset paths. Each report's images are relative to its own json directory (images/…, E01-01/f1.png) and get rebased against the output file
analysis.summary_zh_native: 面向各类 Agent 的 AI 短剧制作 skill 集合
highlights_zh: 样式串味。五份报告共用 57 个类名，其中 13 个同名不同定义（.copy .kpis .badge .chip……），所以给每份样式的每条选择器加作用域前缀
图片路径。各报告的图相对自己那份 json 的目录（images/…、E01-01/f1.png），合成后按输出文件的位置重算
每个 skill 必须有 scripts/selftest.mjs，不调用模型、不花额度，覆盖全部确定性逻辑
脚本串味。各报告的脚本都是 document.querySelector('.expo') 这种全局查询，合成一页后只会命中第一个——五个导出按钮会全废。做法是给每份脚本套一层作用域代理
